fact: Nshimyiryo et al. state, of 76 Ministry of Health facilities studied in four districts in 2017 (69 health centres and 7 hospitals), that heads of service complete paper HMIS forms for the facility data manager, who uploads all the facility's data into DHIS2 by the 5th day of each month, the facility team correcting it in the system until the 15th.
title: Health management information system (HMIS) data verification: A case study in four districts in Rwanda
